report.explanation: All 12 gateway checkout observations returned 200 with durations 63-172 ms; metrics show zero 502s and p95 checkout latency ~247 ms. Traces show successful order, inventory, payment and postgres spans with healthy pool size/idle=1. No evidence supports any taxonomy cause; the alert data is healthy, so no bounded root cause can be established.
missing_evidence: Evidence of actual checkout failures or elevated error rates (e.g., non-200 responses) to substantiate http-500
Saturation or wait-time metrics for the postgres connection pool to substantiate db-pool-exhaustion
Redis latency/timeout metrics or error spans to substantiate redis-timeout
Per-dependency latency breakdown isolating a slow downstream to substantiate downstream-latency
Memory usage time series across services to substantiate memory-leak
Configuration or deployment records showing a faulty change to substantiate bad-configuration
